verdict.rationale: Smithery's own maintained CLI offers scriptable commands (mcp search/add/list/remove, tool list/find/get/call), so it can plausibly be driven from automation. However, nothing documents headless or CI use. The 2026-10-31 shutdown also ended API keys, the hosted Connect services and the service-tied CLI versions, which limits what unattended runs can do beyond querying the public registry. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI documentation, non-interactive auth for CI after API keys were shut down, confirmation that tool-call commands work post-shutdown, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.
The CLI itself continues under the acquirer's org (github.com/arcadeai-labs/smithery-cli, npm smithery@latest) against the public registry
